response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software engineer with 17+ years of experience, he lacks several critical requirements for this embedded networking security role. Most critically, native-level Japanese language proficiency is required but not listed. Additionally, he lacks security expertise, has minimal recent C/C++ experience (last used 2014-2015), no Linux kernel development background, no networking/switch product knowledge, and his recent work is primarily web/mobile (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than embedded firmware. The specific technical foundation required for embedded security development is not evident.
strengths: 17+ years of diverse software engineering experience demonstrating strong technical foundations and ability to master complex systems
Strong DevOps and infrastructure expertise including Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and development environment setup applicable to embedded projects
Proven teaching and mentoring background showing deep technical knowledge and ability to communicate complex concepts
concerns: Missing required native-level Japanese language proficiency—a fundamental requirement for the role
No demonstrated expertise in security technologies (encryption, authentication, device attack detection) core to the position
Limited embedded systems and firmware experience; recent background is primarily web/mobile development with Node.js and TypeScript rather than embedded C and Linux kernel work

key_factors.factor: Embedded C and Linux Kernel Experience
